summary: The diff implements AI chat analysis with parliamentary language remedies, a problems solved widget, and a toggle for enabling/disabling AI remedies. All core requirements appear to be addressed with appropriate backend storage (aiRemedyEnabled field in UserProfile) and frontend UI components. The implementation uses simulated AI analysis rather than external AI services, consistent with non-goals.

hallucinated_features.description: Migration module (backend/migration.mo) that handles data migration between schema versions
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest does not mention data migration requirements. The migration.mo file and Migration.run functionality in main.mo were not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Educational data tracking fields (resolvedProblems, studyTips, academicReminders) in the backend educational data structures
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest focuses on chat analysis and problems solved widget, but does not specify tracking educational-specific problems separately from chat-based problems. The backend adds extensive educational data tracking beyond the scope of requested chat analysis.

hallucinated_features.description: ICTechnologyTip, AIPerformanceReview, and other educational analysis types in the backend
hallucinated_features.reason: These types appear to be part of a broader educational system not mentioned in the BuildRequest, which focuses specifically on chat analysis and remedies.
